news.title: Women's U20 World Cup: Ikpeme Charges Falconets To Approach Sunday's Match With 'Clarity Of Purpose'
news.lede: The acting general secretary of Nigeria Football Federation (NFF), Dr Emmanuel Ikpeme has charged the country’s female youth national team, Falconets to approach Sunday’s last group match versus New Caledonia with ‘clarity of purpose.’ Sports247 repots that, with the Falconets needing a rain of goals to stand any chance of making it to the round of 16 at the ongoing FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup, Ikpeme charged Coach Moses Aduku’s players to fight tooth and nail in order to scale through. A press release from the NFF’s communications department revealed that Ikpeme spoke with the players on phone after their last training session in Łódź, Poland on Saturday, during which he pointed out that the squad must do better than they did in their goalless draw with China.

news.title: Lanzarote before the 100 years of the Federation: more than a century of football, from Campo Salinas to the 2026 World Cup
news.lede: On September 13, 2026, the Interinsular Football Federation of Las Palmas commemorates one hundred years since its establishment. But Lanzarote did not start playing football in 1926. Its history is older and, precisely because of that, the centenary offers an opportunity to tell it in full: from the first footprints of the ball to the 2026 World Cup. On Sunday, September 13, 2026, the Alfredo Kraus Auditorium in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria will be the venue for the central event of the centenary of the Interinsular Football Federation of Las Palmas.

news.title: Sabitzer announces break from Austrian national team, to miss Nations League matches

Francois Nel/Getty Images/AFP (Photo by Francois Nel / GETTY IMAGES NORTH AMERICA / Getty Images via AFP) In a statement released by the Austrian football associations, Sabitzer — who has scored 27 times in 102 appearances for the national side — said that he would reasses his future ahead of the 2028 European Championship qualifiers. CHENNAI Borussia Dortmund midfielder Marcel Sabitzer has announced that he will take a break from the Austrian national team, and will thus not be available for this year’s UEFA Nations League matches.

news.title: A blow for Morocco? Secret agreement leads the 2030 World Cup final to the Santiago Bernabeu
news.lede: The battle has not been officially settled. The media and public rivalry between Spain and Morocco over hosting the 2030 World Cup final rumbles on. FIFA, football's international governing body, sticks to its official position of neutrality, with no final decision yet taken on the venue for the tournament's most important match. The official verdict may be a year away, perhaps not arriving until 2028, yet the current signs look largely clear.

news.title: Ghana U-20 Women eliminated from FIFA World Cup
news.lede: Ghana have been eliminated from the FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup after suffering a heavy 4-0 defeat to France in their final Group C game on Saturday, September 12. The Black Princesses needed a positive result of at least a draw to keep their chances of reaching the knockout stage alive. Clara Bertrand opened the scoring for France before Justine Rouquet doubled the advantage. Rouquet completed her brace to put France firmly in control, while Ornella Graziani added the fourth goal to seal a convincing victory for the European side.

news.title: Kunsanama appointed Zambia U-15 head coach ahead of FIFA World Cup
news.lede: Football Association of Zambia (FAZ) has appointed Brian Kunsanama as head coach of the Zambia Under-15 boys’ national team ahead of the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival. Kunsanama will lead a newly constituted technical bench tasked with preparing Zambia for the global youth tournament, which will be held in Baku, Azerbaijan, from 22 to 31 October 2026. FAZ general secretary Charles Chakatazya confirmed that Kunsanama will be assisted by Lawrence Lubinda, Josephat Nkhoma, Brian Lubaba and Joyford Mambe. Former Zambia and Zanaco goalkeeper Racha Kola has been appointed goalkeeper coach, while Mike Mudenda will serve as physical trainer.
